title: The Confused boy at the desk
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：confused　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 confused 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the builder wrote of ① a confused boy at the desk in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more confused than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the confused ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most confused boy at the desk anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1965 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too confused to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the confused ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a confused account of the night, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as confused as the account of the night they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was confused or not, and he said so.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something confused, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite confused; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the confused ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981, in silence, she wrote of another confused boy at the desk in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more confused than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most confused account of the night in the whole site, she said in 1983, was the one she could never quite name; the confused ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 困惑（前置定语 a confused boy at the desk：1971 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件困惑的少年）
B. adj. 困惑／混乱（比较级 more confused than：文中两处，一处比桌边的少年，一处比预想）
C. adj. 困惑／混乱（最高级 the most confused：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 困惑（表语 too confused to do：母亲觉得它太困惑，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 混乱（前置定语 a confused account of the night：叔叔把整件事称作一桩混乱的说法）
F. adj. 混乱（同级比较 as confused as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩那晚的说法相比）
G. adj. 混乱（后置定语 something confused：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 混乱（受程度副词修饰 quite confused：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a confused boy at the desk
the most confused boy at the desk anybody
a confused account of the night
The most confused account of the night in

answers.why: confused 意为“困惑”，1971 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件困惑的少年”，此处作前置定语 a confused boy at the desk。
confused 意为“困惑”，此处用比较级 more confused than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
confused 意为“困惑”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最困惑的一件，故用最高级 the most confused boy at the desk。
confused 意为“困惑”，母亲认为这件东西“太困惑了，谁也用不上”，too confused to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
confused 意为“混乱”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩混乱的说法”，此处作前置定语 a confused account of the night。
confused 意为“混乱”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩那晚的说法一样混乱”，同级比较用 as confused as。
confused 意为“混乱”，施工图上那半行字要的是“混乱的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something confused。
confused 意为“混乱”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当混乱”，quite 修饰原级 confused。
confused 意为“混乱”，1981 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要混乱”，故用比较级 more confused than。
confused 意为“混乱”，母亲 1983 年说的是“整个工地里最混乱的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most confused account of the night。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件困惑的少年。（a confused boy at the desk）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更困惑。（more confused than …）
母亲觉得它太困惑，谁也用不上。（too confused to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩混乱的说法。（a confused account of the night）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩那晚的说法一样混乱。（as confused as …）
到了 1978 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件混乱的东西。（something confused）
answers: In 1971 the builder wrote of a confused boy at the desk in the plan.
Everybody said it was more confused than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too confused to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a confused account of the night.
He said nobody would call it as confused as the account of the night they had once had.
By 1978 the plan asked for nothing but something confused.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 confused 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the builder wrote of a confused boy at the desk in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most confused boy at the desk in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too confused to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a confused account of the night, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite confused, and everybody laughed.
The confused ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
